summary.heading: What is The Funfair?
paragraphs: The Funfair is a free 3D theme park game that runs in your web browser, with nothing to download. You walk around the park, ride coasters and thrill rides, play carnival games and races, build your own coaster in the Coaster Workshop, and fly an Airbus A320neo 40 km south to the island of Palm Cay.

Anyone can walk in and look around as a guest. Rides and games use tickets that come free with an account: 20 every 5 hours. The Funfair is made by Hasan Hmedeh, a full-stack software developer, and the park's Career Museum is his interactive CV.

attractions.heading: What's in the park
attractions.lead: Coasters you drive yourself, carnival games, karts and a buggy, a coaster builder, and a whole world past the park gates. Walk into any ride's glowing ring and press E to play.

groups.heading: Thrill rides and coasters
groups.lead: Two rollercoasters, a giant wheel and three rides that turn you upside down.

cards.name: Thunder Loop
cards.text: Drive the coaster yourself: power with W, brake with S and hit turbo with Shift through a launch, a loop, a zero-g roll and a helix.

cards.name: Sky Falcon
cards.text: A 4.25 km cliff coaster: climb to the clifftop, drop 158 m at 90°, then launch to 250 km/h.

cards.name: Rocket Ride
cards.text: Fire six stages, from lift-off through the clouds to a stylised orbit 500 m above the fair.

cards.name: Giant Wheel
cards.text: Ride a 250 m wheel with 48 capsules over the park, and hold W to fast-forward the turn.

cards.name: Sky Flip
cards.text: Swing 125 m up and right over the top, head over heels, at about 200 km/h.

cards.name: Nebula 360
cards.text: A pendulum ship that loops right round three times, then hangs you upside down 30 m up.

groups.heading: Carnival games
groups.lead: Quick rounds on the midway, with your personal bests kept on your account.

cards.name: Duck Shoot
cards.text: 30 seconds with a cork gun to knock down the tin ducks, and the golden one worth 50 points.

cards.name: High Striker
cards.text: Three swings to ring the bell at the top of a 9 m tower: time the meter just right.

cards.name: Crate Smash
cards.text: 45 seconds to run, roll and kick your way through 22 crates stacked in rows.

groups.heading: Driving, racing and flying
groups.lead: Karts, a rally buggy and a camera drone, each with its own cameras.

cards.name: Turbo Speedway
cards.text: Race three rivals for three laps round a 472 m kart circuit full of cones, oil and boost pads.

cards.name: Rally Trail
cards.text: A buggy time trial with jumps, mud and crates. Race the ghost of your best run and chase today's top ten.

cards.name: Drone Flights
cards.text: Rent a camera drone for 120 seconds and climb to 320 m, high enough to look down on the Giant Wheel.

cards.name: Coaster Workshop
cards.text: Build a coaster from straights, curves, slopes, helixes, loops and corkscrews, test-ride it for free and send it to the staff. Released coasters open on a plot in Creators' Valley, and you earn tickets each time someone rides yours.

groups.heading: Fly to Palm Cay
groups.lead: The world goes on past the gates: take the SkyLink to the airport, fly yourself 40 km south, and play on a tropical island.

cards.name: SkyLink
cards.text: The driverless train from the park's south gate to the airport, on a guideway 11 m up. Free, and no account needed.

cards.name: Funfair International
cards.text: Walk through check-in, security and duty free to Gate 3, past A320s at the gates and a 3,500 m runway.

cards.name: Fly the A320neo
cards.text: Take the captain's seat: push back, taxi, take off, cruise at 5,000 ft over the sea and land it yourself. ATC, the autopilot and your first officer help, and every landing gets 1 to 5 stars.

cards.name: Palm Cay
cards.text: The tropical island at the end of the flight: a palm promenade, beaches, a lagoon and four games of its own.

extra.name: Jet-Ski Race
extra.text: Three laps of a buoy course in the lagoon against the island's riders. A missed buoy costs 3 seconds.

extra.name: Splash Tower
extra.text: Climb the 24 m tower and pick your slide: the Kamikaze drop, the Typhoon tube or the Lazy Loop.

extra.name: Pirate Cannons
extra.text: Man the three guns of Fort Cutlass and sink the pirate ships before the 60 seconds run out.

extra.name: Beach Volley
extra.text: Ten serves with an island partner against two locals, with coconuts to hit for bonus points.

cards.name: Career Museum
cards.text: Take the guided tour of Hasan Hmedeh's work, from 2019 to today, one framed exhibit at a time. It's the creator's CV, built into the park.

groups.heading: Your look, and a park full of people

cards.name: Changing room
cards.text: Pick who you are from a cast of realistic people, dye your top, bottoms, shoes and hair, and adjust your height and build. Change again whenever you like in the changing room beside Rosa's booth.
cards.more: You're never alone in the park: guests arrive as couples, friends and families, queue for the rides, sit on the benches and try the High Striker. Travellers and crew fill the airport, and holidaymakers lounge on Palm Cay's beaches.

howToPlay.heading: How to play
howToPlay.lead: The Funfair plays best with a keyboard and mouse, and touch works too. Keys follow their position on the keyboard, so ZQSD works on AZERTY.

rows.action: Play, in a ride's glowing ring
Walk; push it all the way to run
Every ride's controls, including a full cockpit for the flight
Thunder Loop: power, brake, turbo, camera
Sky Falcon, Giant Wheel, Sky Flip, Nebula 360: camera · look around · get off
Karts and buggy: drive, nitro, drift, rescue
Drone: fly, turn, climb, descend, fly home
A320neo: pitch, roll, take-off thrust, gear, autopilot, time warp, and many more

notes: Choose Auto, High, Medium, Low or Very low graphics in the game. Phones get lighter settings automatically.

tickets.heading: Tickets and accounts
tickets.lead: Walking in is free for everyone. A free account adds free tickets for every ride and game.

cards.title: Walk in as a guest
cards.text: No account needed to explore: walk the whole park, kick the giant FUNFAIR letters, visit Rosa's booth, tour the Career Museum, ride the SkyLink, walk the airport and change your look.

cards.title: Free account, free tickets
cards.text: Sign up with Google or email to collect 20 tickets every 5 hours. Most rides and games cost 1 ticket, the Sky Falcon and the Giant Wheel 5, and the flight to Palm Cay 10. Leftover tickets carry over.

cards.title: Treats and souvenirs
cards.text: Spend tickets at Rosa's booth on treats with perks, like Cotton Candy (run 40% faster for 3 minutes), and on souvenirs you wear, from Star Shades to the Ringmaster's Top Hat.

cards.title: Paid extras
cards.text: There are no real-money payments in the park today. Paid extras, such as an extra Coaster Workshop design slot, are coming soon.

tickets.note: Accounts are for ages 15 and up, or younger with a parent's or guardian's permission. Your rounds, orders and souvenirs are kept on your account, and you can delete it from the game at any time.

tutorials.heading: Tutorials
tutorials.lead: Short videos that show you around: from your first steps in the park to landing the A320neo on Palm Cay.

items.a: Yes. The game is free to play in your browser. Walking around is free for everyone, and rides and games use tickets that come free with an account: currently 20 every 5 hours.

items.q: Do I need to download or install anything?
items.a: No. The Funfair runs in your web browser, so there is nothing to download or install. It needs an internet connection, and it doesn't work offline.

items.q: Does it work on phones and tablets?
items.a: Yes. On a touch screen you get a joystick and on-screen buttons for every ride, including a full cockpit for the flight, and phones get lighter graphics automatically. It plays best with a keyboard.

items.q: Which browsers does it work in?
items.a: Any recent browser with WebGL 2, such as Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. If your browser can't run it, the game tells you so.
Not to look around: guests can walk the whole park, visit the booth, tour the museum, ride the SkyLink and change their look. Rides and games need a free account, which comes with free tickets.

Tickets are free virtual items you spend on rides and games: 1 for most, 5 for the Sky Falcon and the Giant Wheel, and 10 for the flight to Palm Cay. They have no cash value, and there is nothing to buy with real money today.

No. The Funfair is single-player, and other players don't appear in your world. The park is shared and live, though: staff open and close rides in real time, the Rally Trail has a daily top ten, and coasters built by other players open in Creators' Valley.

The action is mild and cartoon-like: a cork gun at tin ducks, cannons at pirate ships, and kicks that make guests hop out of the way. There is no chat. Accounts are for ages 15 and up, or younger with a parent's or guardian's permission, and some rides have flashing lights and intense motion.

items.q: What language is the game in?
items.a: The game's interface is in English. This website is also in French and Arabic.

items.q: Can I play with a gamepad?
items.a: Not at the moment. The Funfair plays with a keyboard and mouse, or with touch.

items.q: How big is the download, and how much data does it use?
items.a: The first visit downloads a whole 3D park (models, textures and code), which is a lot for a web page, so use Wi-Fi if your data is limited. The airport and the island load only when you travel there.

items.q: How do I report a bug or suggest an idea?
items.a: Use the Idea Box in the park: pick a topic such as "Something's wrong", write up to 500 characters, and follow its status from Waiting to Done. It needs a free account. You can also email [hassanhmedeh@gmail.com](mailto:hassanhmedeh@gmail.com).
Hasan Hmedeh, a full-stack software developer. The park's Career Museum is his interactive CV, and it's free to visit.

creator.heading: Made by Hasan Hmedeh
paragraphs: The Funfair is built by Hasan Hmedeh, a full-stack software developer who has been writing code since 2019. He made the park with three.js in the browser, and the accounts and tickets server with NestJS and PostgreSQL.
Inside the park, the Career Museum walks you through his work from 2019 to today, one framed exhibit at a time. It's his CV, turned into a place you can visit.
